newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds permanent reserves via coupon pass.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds permanent reserves via coupon pass.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added permanent reserves to the U.S. banking system on Tuesday via a coupon pass, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
The Fed bought coupons from February 29, 2000 to February 28, 2002 for delivery on Thursday, the spokeswoman said.
U.S. money market analysts had said the Fed might add permanent reserves to the banking system at any time.
The move follows another purchase of coupons carried out by the Fed a week ago.
